message.content: The consensus among critics and audiences alike points to **“Parasite”** as the standout film of 2020. Directed by Bong Joon‑ho, the Korean dark‑comedy thriller not only swept the major awards—winning Best Picture at the Oscars—but also earned universal acclaim for its sharp social commentary, masterful pacing, and genre‑blending storytelling. Its impact on global cinema and its record‑breaking accolades make it the most celebrated movie of that year.
